Until A8 runs, those rows are still in git history with nothing reading them' -- A8 (scripts/ops/import_archived_registers.py) has ALREADY run: `python3 scripts/ops/import_archived_registers.py --dry-run` reproduces the exact historical counts (open=1065, monitoring=91) and matching records already exist in docs/claude/work/pipeline/ with origin.ref pointing at the archived register files (e.g. BL-20260812-TRAINER-STRAY-REPO-ROOT-JOURNAL-DB, origin.ref=docs/archive/2026-09-21-operating-reset/registers/health-review-backlog.json#...).
